2684-five-tales.title: Five Tales
2684-five-tales.creator: John Galsworthy
2684-five-tales.description: A book by John Galsworthy. he strain of that long attention to the multiple threads of argument and evidence to be disentangled--work profoundly interesting, as a rule, to his clear intellect, trained to almost instinctive rejection of all but the essential, to selection of what was legally vital out of the mass of confused tactical and human detail presented to his scrutiny; yet sometimes tedious and wearing.

arxiv-2105-06973.title: Multiparty Session Types for Safe Runtime Adaptation in an Actor Language (Extended version)
arxiv-2105-06973.creator: Paul Harvey, Simon Fowler, Ornela Dardha, Simon J. Gay
arxiv-2105-06973.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Paul Harvey, Simon Fowler, Ornela Dardha, Simon J. Gay. Human fallibility, unpredictable operating environments, and the heterogeneity of hardware devices are driving the need for software to be able to adapt as seen in the Internet of Things or telecommunication networks. Unfortunately, mainstream programming languages do not readily allow a software component to sense and respond to its operating environment, by discovering , replacing , and communicating with components that are not part of the original system design, while maintaining static correctness guarantees.

arxiv-2205-07696.title: Let’s Trace It: Fine-Grained Serverless Benchmarking using Synchronous and Asynchronous Orchestrated Applications
arxiv-2205-07696.creator: Joel Scheuner, Simon Eismann, Sacheen Talluri, Erwin van Eyk, Cristina L. Abad, Philipp Leitner, Alexandru Iosup
arxiv-2205-07696.description: Abstract Making serverless computing widely applicable requires detailed performance understanding. Although contemporary benchmarking approaches exist, they report only coarse results, do not apply distributed tracing, do not consider asynchronous applications, and provide limited capabilities for (root cause) analysis. Addressing this gap, we design and implement ServiBench, a serverless benchmarking suite.

arxiv-2206-13445.title: Accurate solutions to time dependent transport problems with a moving mesh and exact uncollided source treatments
arxiv-2206-13445.creator: William Bennett
arxiv-2206-13445.description: Abstract To find benchmark quality solutions to time dependent S n S_{n} transport problems, we develop a numerical method in a Discontinuous Galerkin (DG) framework that utilizes time dependent cell edges, called a moving mesh, and an uncollided source treatment.

arxiv-2303-03981.title: “If I Had All the Time in the World”: Ophthalmologists’ Perceptions of Anchoring Bias Mitigation in Clinical AI Support Conference: Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 23–28, 2023; Hamburg, Germany Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factor
arxiv-2303-03981.creator: Anne Kathrine Petersen Bach, Trine Munch Nørgaard, Jens Christian Brok, Niels van Berkel
arxiv-2303-03981.description: Abstract . Clinical needs and technological advances have resulted in increased use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in clinical decision support. However, such support can introduce new and amplify existing cognitive biases. Through contextual inquiry and interviews, we set out to understand the use of an existing AI support system by ophthalmologists.

arxiv-2403-00752.title: An Experimental Study of Low-Latency Video Streaming over 5G
arxiv-2403-00752.creator: Imran Khan 1 , Tuyen X. Tran 2 , Matti Hiltunen 2 , Theodore Karagioules 2 , Dimitrios Koutsonikolas 1
arxiv-2403-00752.description: Abstract Low-latency video streaming over 5G has become rapidly popular over the last few years due to its increased usage in hosting virtual events, online education, webinars, and all-hands meetings. Our work aims to address the absence of studies that reveal the real-world behavior of low-latency video streaming.

arxiv-2407-14111.title: A Mirror Descent-Based Algorithm for Corruption-Tolerant Distributed Gradient Descent
arxiv-2407-14111.creator: Shuche Wang, Vincent Y. F. Tan
arxiv-2407-14111.description: Abstract Distributed gradient descent algorithms have come to the fore in modern machine learning, especially in parallelizing the handling of large datasets that are distributed across several workers. However, scant attention has been paid to analyzing the behavior of distributed gradient descent algorithms in the presence of adversarial corruptions instead of random noise.

arxiv-2407-19422.title: A Generic Review of Integrating Artificial Intelligence in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
arxiv-2407-19422.creator: Meng Jiang, Qing Zhao, Jianqiang Li, Fan Wang, Tianyu He, Xinyan Cheng, Bing Xiang Yang, Grace W.K. Ho, Guanghui Fu
arxiv-2407-19422.description: Abstract Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is a well-established intervention for mitigating psychological issues by modifying maladaptive cognitive and behavioral patterns. However, delivery of CBT is often constrained by resource limitations and barriers to access. Advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) have provided technical support for the digital transformation of CBT.

pmc-11350398.title: Absolute control over the quantum yield of a photodissociation reaction mediated by nonadiabatic couplings
pmc-11350398.creator: Ignacio R. Sola, Alberto García-Vela
pmc-11350398.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Control of molecular reaction dynamics with laser pulses has been developed in the last decades. Among the different magnitudes whose control has been actively pursued, the branching ratio between different product channels constitutes the clearest signature of quantum control. In polyatomic molecules, the dynamics in the excited state is quagmired by non-adiabatic couplings, which are not directly affected by the laser, making control over the branching ratio a very demanding challenge.

pmc-11543860.title: Particularities of Pyelonephritis With Multidrug-Resistant (MDR) Germs During Pregnancy: A Case-Control Study
pmc-11543860.creator: Viorel Dragos Radu, Cristian Radu Costache, Pavel Onofrei, Rodica Radu, Bogdan Novac
pmc-11543860.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: The aim of this study was to analyze the characteristics of pyelonephritis with multidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria in pregnant women in comparison to pyelonephritis with multidrug-sensitive bacteria in this particular patient group.Methods: We conducted a retrospective study over a period of three years on a study group of 17 pregnant patients with pyelonephritis with MDR bacteria and on a control group of 52 pregnant patients with pyelonephritis with multidrug-sensitive bacteria.

pmc-11677376.title: Etiology-Dependent Microbiome Differences in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Development
pmc-11677376.creator: Nevena Todorovic, Serena Martinelli, Giulia Nannini, Ralf Weiskirchen, Amedeo Amedei
pmc-11677376.description: Chronic liver disease is characterised by persistent inflammation, tissue damage, and regeneration, which leads to steatosis, fibrosis, and, lastly, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). HCC, the most prevalent form of primary liver cancer, is one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide.

pmc-12470426.title: Long-Term Impact of Tonsillectomy on Quality of Life (QoL) in Patients with Palatine Tonsillitis and Palatine Tonsillar Hypertrophy
pmc-12470426.creator: Aleksander Jurkiewicz, Przemysław Bant, Kornel Szczygielski, Michał Kaczmarczyk, Dariusz Jurkiewicz, Andres Soto-Varela
pmc-12470426.description: Tonsillectomy is one of the most common surgical procedures and, given the limited efficacy of conservative treatment, remains the primary approach for managing palatine tonsillitis (PT) and palatine tonsillar hypertrophy (PTH). Both conditions negatively affect quality of life (QoL), increase healthcare costs, and contribute to work absenteeism.

pmc-12561395.title: A Systematic Review of Literature on the Association Among Sleep, Cortisol Level and Cardiovascular Health Within the Healthcare Shift Worker Population
pmc-12561395.creator: Aslah Nabilah Abdull Sukor, Norsham Juliana, Nazefah Abdul Hamid, Nur Islami Mohd Fahmi Teng, Muslimah Ithnin, Sahar Azmani, Sazzli Shahlan Kasim, Alfredo Caturano
pmc-12561395.description: Shift workers are commonly associated with circadian misalignment due to irregular working hours, which often leads to poor sleep quality and is associated with HPA axis misalignment and changes in cardiovascular outcome. Background: This systematic review aimed to investigate the association between cortisol production and cardiovascular health with sleep quality in healthcare shift workers.

pmc-12598368.title: A Dosimetric Comparison of Coplanar Versus Noncoplanar Volumetric Modulated Arc Therapy (VMAT) for High Grade Glioma
pmc-12598368.creator: Sagar Raut, Rajesh Pasricha, Manoj Gupta, Deepa Joseph, Sweety Gupta, Rachit Ahuja, Laxman Pandey, Aathira T S, Nidhi Sharma, Debanjan Sikdar
pmc-12598368.description: Objective: This study aims to compare the dosimetric differences in radiotherapy plans generated by coplanar volumetric-modulated arc therapy (cVMAT) and noncoplanar volumetric-modulated arc therapy (NcVMAT) for high-grade gliomas.Material and methods: This is a single-institutional, prospective, observational study conducted during a period of one year from December 2018 to October 2019.

pmc-12690215.title: MRI performance to identify clinically significant prostate cancer following focal cryo‐ablation
pmc-12690215.creator: Herbert Lepor, Samuel Parry, Majlinda Tafa, Eli Rapoport, James S Wysock
pmc-12690215.description: ObjectivesTo determine the performance of MRI for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) recurrence following focal cryo‐ablation over five years of oncological surveillance.Subjects and MethodsA total of 305 men with intermediate‐risk prostate cancer undergoing focal cryo‐ablation (FCA) at our referral centre between 03/2017 and 03/2024 were prospectively enrolled in an outcomes registry.

pmc-12694978.title: Monosodium glutamate is associated with dose-dependent reproductive toxicity and sperm dysfunction in male wistar rats
pmc-12694978.creator: Olaleke Abraham Fasasi, Babatunde Oluwaseun Ibitoye, Adesua Emmanuel Ogunmokunwa, Adebanji Modupe Akingbade, Adebukola Olubosede Omolayo
pmc-12694978.description: Objective:Monosodium glutamate (E621) is widely used as a flavor enhancer and is added to many processed foods, often concealed by the label E621. Controversies exist regarding its safety, as most studies use high doses that are challenging to translate to human relevance.

pmc-13103952.title: Overweight and Obesity Are Associated with Lower Renal Blood Flow in Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease
pmc-13103952.creator: Carissa L. Birznieks, Wei Wang, Cortney Steele, Zhiying You, Berenice Gitomer, Michel Chonchol, Kristen L. Nowak
pmc-13103952.description: IntroductionWe have previously reported that overweight and obesity are independently associated with more rapid disease progression in adults with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD). In this study, we perform a cross-sectional analysis to evaluate whether overweight and obesity are also associated with renal blood flow (RBF) in this patient population.

pmc-13365510.title: Structural analysis of the rural household food security system in Gorgan County, Iran
pmc-13365510.creator: Ahmad Abedi Sarvestani, Manizheh Mohammadkhani, Farhad Shirani Bidabadi
pmc-13365510.description: Food security is a complex, dynamic, and multidimensional issue, particularly critical for rural households facing intertwined economic, social, infrastructural, and environmental challenges. This study aims to analyze the structural configuration of the rural household food security system in Gorgan County, northern Iran, using Interpretive Structural Modeling.

pmc-13430777.title: Organoids as next-generation models for investigating intracranial tumours
pmc-13430777.creator: Subham Roy, Fahmida Zahin, Princess Afia Nkrumah-Boateng, Saim Chaudhry, Maher Nassor, Maame Fosuah Appiah Kwarteng, Akosua Bempomaa Owusu-Boampong, Andrew Awuah Wireko
pmc-13430777.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Tumour organoids have emerged as important tools in brain tumour research, addressing long-standing limitations of conventional two-dimensional cultures, xenograft models, and genetically engineered mouse models. By preserving patient-specific genetic alterations, cellular diversity, spatial architecture, and key microenvironmental features, organoid systems enable more faithful modelling of tumour biology across a broad range of intracranial tumours, including gliomas, meningiomas, medulloblastomas, pituitary tumours, and craniopharyngiomas.

pmc-13459754.title: Reducing unmeasured confounding from non-compliance with randomization in surgical RCTs: a simulation study
pmc-13459754.creator: Zhenzhen Lu, Wenwen Li, Mengyao Wang, Lihong Huang, Feng Chen
pmc-13459754.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundNon-compliance with randomization is pervasive in surgical randomized controlled trials (RCTs), introducing unmeasured confounding that undermines valid causal inference. Conventional methods, such as intention-to-treat (ITT), per-protocol (PP), as-treated (AT) and instrumental variable (IV) analysis, exhibit significant limitations.MethodsWe conducted a simulation study to compare the performance of negative control methods (NCM), including difference-in-differences (DiD) and double negative controls (DNC), with traditional approaches (ITT, PP, AT, IV).

pmc-13477080.title: Mortality and morbidity benefits of surgical versus transcatheter aortic valve replacement in patients ≤60 years: Findings from a national cohort
pmc-13477080.creator: Jessan A Jishu, Yara Menassa, Patrick Kearns, Mahmoud Omar, Cameron Galic, Soubhi Tahhan, Shriya Chunduri, Aabha Divya, Joseph M Obeid, Jamil F Borgi
pmc-13477080.description: ObjectiveTo compare outcomes of surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) with transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) in patients aged ≤60 years throughout the United States.MethodsPatients aged ≤60 years with aortic stenosis undergoing either first-time SAVR or TAVR between January 2006 and December 2025 were identified from TriNetX, an administrative real-world database. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality over 5 years.

pmc-13565897.title: Overcoming the Limitations of Protein A: Evolution of Bacterial Protein-Based and Synthetic Affinity Ligands for High-Performance IgG Purification
pmc-13565897.creator: Larisa N. Ikryannikova, Mikhail N. Tereshin, Milena V. Baskova, Kristina P. Telepenina, Neonila V. Gorokhovets, Daniel R. Bayzigitov, Eugenia A. Gurylina, Vasiliy N. Stepanenko, Tatiana D. Melikhova
pmc-13565897.description: Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) are widely used as therapeutic molecules for the treatment of serious diseases, primarily cancer. The market for mAbs is one of the fastest-growing segments of the biopharmaceuticals industry. Purification is a crucial stage in the production of mAbs.
